summary: A friendly show-and-tell evening focused on developer productivity tooling: generators, internal CLIs, automated docs, and pragmatic AI-assisted workflows that don’t compromise code quality.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.content:
## Dev Productivity Show & Tell

We all build little tools to make life easier: scripts, generators, templates, checks, dashboards.

This activity is a lightweight evening where people demo:

- internal CLIs (project bootstrap, migrations, seeders)
- documentation automation
- code quality helpers (linting, formatting, CI gates)
- AI-assisted workflows (safely, with guardrails)

Demos can be **5–10 minutes**. No pressure to be perfect.

sections.heading: Demo ideas
sections.content:
### What you can present

- A script that saved you hours (even a small one)
- A migration workflow you finally made safe
- An approach to keep constants/enums in sync across FE/BE
- A CI pipeline improvement
- A reliable test strategy for tricky integrations

#### AI tooling (optional)

If you present AI usage, focus on:

- how you prevent wrong changes
- how you validate outputs
- what guardrails keep quality high

sections.heading: Flow
sections.content:
### Agenda

- **19:00–19:10** Welcome + lightning introductions
- **19:10–20:20** Demos (6–8 slots)
- **20:20–20:40** Break + networking
- **20:40–21:40** Demos (remaining slots)
- **21:40–22:00** Wrap-up + shared notes

We’ll collect links and tips into a shared page after the session.

sections.heading: Community notes
sections.content:
## How to participate

- You can present or just attend
- Questions are encouraged, but keep them constructive
- If you share code, redact secrets and private customer details

> The goal is to learn practical patterns we can apply the next day.
